description_en: Pushes usage deduction for a prepaid per-use product to Alibaba Cloud Marketplace on behalf of a service provider
description_zh: 用于服务商向云市场推送用户预付费按次计费商品的使用次数扣减
name: PushTimesUsage

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Marketplace instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of uses to deduct. The value must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次扣减的使用次数。取值必须大于0
parameters.name: times

parameters.help_en: The client token that ensures the idempotency of the request. We recommend that you use a UUID. The same `ClientToken` can be submitted only once within 24 hours. Use the same `ClientToken` when retrying the same operation. Use a new `ClientToken` for new business operations
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性的客户端令牌。建议使用UUID。同一个 `ClientToken` 在24小时内仅允许提交一次。重试同一笔操作时必须使用相同的 `ClientToken`，新的业务操作请使用新的 `ClientToken`
parameters.name: client_token
